keepFormat.title: Preserve surrounding whitespace & quotes
keepFormat.description: Keep leading/trailing whitespace or outer quote delimiters ("...", '...', `...`) when replacing selected text.

stripArticlesInIdentifier.title: Strip articles when building identifiers
stripArticlesInIdentifier.description: Remove leading English articles (a, an, the) when formatting camelCase, snake_case, and related candidates.

autoReplace.title: Auto-replace with preferred naming style
autoReplace.description: Directly apply the top preferred naming style without showing a selection picker.

selectTargetLanguageBeforeReplacement.title: Pick target language before replacing
selectTargetLanguageBeforeReplacement.description: Ask for the target language before running Translate & Replace.

docBilingualMode.title: Bilingual document output
docBilingualMode.description: Output original text paired with translation for Markdown, code documents, and Jupyter (.ipynb) notebooks.

foldOriginalInDoc.title: Fold original blocks in Markdown output
foldOriginalInDoc.description: Wrap original paragraphs inside collapsible <details> blocks when generating bilingual Markdown output.

openDocPreviewTab.title: Open preview/diff tab for translated documents
openDocPreviewTab.description: Open a read-only preview or diff tab automatically after translating a document or documentation comment.

preserveInlineTagsInDoc.title: Protect inline tags in comments & docs
preserveInlineTagsInDoc.description: Preserve Javadoc/KDoc/JSDoc/HTML/Markdown inline tags ({@link ...}, {@code ...}, ..., `...`, URLs) verbatim during translation.
